llvm-beanz 2023-09-05T16:53:59Z
I feel like the user interface here is still really awkward, but we can address that in a follow up change.



I think a better approach would be to have the `-p` option be optional and have it default to `os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))`. Then we could add `#!/usr/bin/env python3` to the top of the script, mark it executable, and have a build step that copies it into the `bin` folder during the build process. That would make for a nice development experience.
